findings.description: The watch case reads as silver/steel-toned from 00:00 through ~04:00, but at 08:00 the case is distinctly gold/rose-gold toned with a warm dial tint. The surrounding lighting is unchanged (shirt stripes and skin tone consistent), so the color shift is not explained by ambient light and suggests either a shot change or an inconsistent prop. Could alternatively be an extreme reflection-angle effect, hence not higher confidence.
